name: Large Address Aware check (no patch)
author: n/a
notes: Verify only. Steam 1.67 TS3W.exe already has LAA (Characteristics 0x123) [verified]. Warn if a Steam verify ever clears it; never patch by default.

name: Ultimate ASI Loader (Win32)
author: ThirteenAG

removeLegacy: ddraw.dll (only if its version resource says Ultimate ASI Loader)
any wininet.dll bundled with MonoPatcher or Smooth Patch

notes: MIT. Published 2026-08-16. Exactly one loader. The DLL name inside the Win32 zip (dinput8.dll) is [community]; confirm on first unpack. Never name it d3d9.dll (DXVK uses that).

name: DXVK (x32 d3d9.dll)
author: doitsujin
notes: Zlib. Published 2026-09-15. Built-in TS3W.exe profile spoofs GeForce GTX 580 (10de:1080) [verified config.cpp], so no GraphicsRules edits. Leave d3d9.textureMemory at default.

name: dxvk.conf for The Sims 3
author: sims-3-modernization
notes: Generated, not downloaded. One frame cap only: the S3SS Precise limiter by default.

name: GraphicsRules.sgr: real VRAM fallback under DXVK
author: sims-3-modernization
notes: [verified 2026-10-11] Under DXVK the engine reads texture memory as 0, so GraphicsRules.sgr falls back to 32 MB (DeviceConfig.log: "Texture memory: 32MB <<OVERRIDE>>"), GPU memory level Low, and the first-run detection writes low presets (texture/sim/lighting/terrain quality 1; vanilla D3D9 picked 3-4). textureMemory only feeds those presets (no runtime budget in the rules), so the game must redo detection: delete Options.ini, start the game once, then re-run options-ini. Steam "verify files" reverts the patch.

name: Sims 3 Settings Setter
author: sims3fiend
notes: No license file: download from GitHub, never re-host. Published 2026-07-20. Patterns match Steam 1.67 [verified]. Includes the Alder Lake fix (CPU Thread Optimization).

name: S3SS patch selection (S3SS.toml)
author: sims-3-modernization
notes: Schema: [patches.<InternalName>] enabled + settings by name, [qol.*] [verified from S3SS source]. Merge into an existing file; keep other keys. Set OversizedThreadStackFix=false on the first S3PP run. Never AdaptiveWait together with S3PP ShortWaitSpin. Set qol.ui.disable_overlay=true if the overlay crashes with DXVK.

name: Smooth Patch tuning package (ld_SmoothPatch.package)
author: LazyDuchess
notes: Package only (46,524 bytes; CAS load, CAS audio and Create-a-Style fixes). Do NOT install TS3Patch.asi, TS3Patch.txt or wininet.dll from the zip. Unsupported since 2026-01-26; the S3SS README says to keep this package [verified]. MTS getfile link changes with each update; read it from the page.

name: Smooth Patch ASI (TS3Patch.asi), legacy: remove
author: LazyDuchess
notes: Excluded. Patches the same SleepEx wrapper (0x004E1320) as the S3SS Smooth Patch [verified]. The installer moves it to the backup folder if found.

name: MonoPatcher
author: LazyDuchess
notes: No license file. The API exposes no digest; zip is 811,083 bytes; record our own hash on first download. Skip the bundled wininet.dll. Needs the VC++ x86 redistributable. Signatures match Steam 1.67 [verified]. If it crashes, remove MonoPatcher.asi; the listed fixes only need the package [community].

name: NRaas ErrorTrap (Steam 1.67 build)
author: NRaas (Twallan, Chain-Reaction)
notes: The only NRaas mod with per-version builds: take the 1.67 one, not 1.69 [community]. nraas.net blocks scripted fetches (403), so this is a manual download. Version unknown.

name: NRaas Overwatch
author: NRaas

config.inGameReminder: With simler90-core: City Hall > NRaas > Overwatch > Settings > Set Alarm Hour = 5 (default 3), once per new save

notes: Resets stuck Sims; cleans up cars, elevators and stereos. Manual download, version unknown.

name: NRaas Saver

name: NRaas Traveler

name: simler90's Gameplay Core Mod (Steam)
author: simler90
notes: Updated 2026-09-20; package is 12,807,314 bytes [verified page]. Steam build only. Not compatible with any other mod that modifies Sims3GameplaySystems.dll or Sims3GameplayObjects.dll [verified]. There is no NRaas-specific variant. NRaas won't support saves that use it. The policy allows modified re-releases on free sites, not re-hosting the original. Best on a new save.

name: Mods\Resource.cfg (Packages + Overrides)
author: community
notes: Generated. The local file has no Overrides entries [verified]. Priority values are convention; Overrides must outrank Packages. Create Mods\Overrides.

name: No Intro (all intro videos incl. Maxis logo)
author: sims-3-modernization
notes: Built by our own script (empty VP6 stubs for 14 videos). Community alternative: https://modthesims.info/d/497903 (nointromaxis.zip). Use only one.

name: Options.ini performance settings
author: community
notes: Keys verified in the local file; the benefits are [community] (Steam guide Bonus Step). Edit in place and keep other keys. Re-apply on each run: the game resets options after GPU driver updates. fullscreen = 0 keeps the game windowed so the harness and Claude can run next to it (a fresh Options.ini defaults to fullscreen).

name: Clear game caches after mod changes
author: community
notes: Paths are relative to Documents\Electronic Arts\The Sims 3. Don't clear on every launch.

name: Sims 3 Performance Patch (beta)
author: Sonja92yu
notes: Nexus account, manual download (403 to scripts; version from docs/01, not re-checked). Overlaps S3SS: ThreadStackDiet vs OversizedThreadStackFix (first run with the S3SS one off); ShortWaitSpin vs AdaptiveWait (never both). Watch for blank or wrong UI text (LocalizedStringCache).

name: Tiny UI Fix
author: just-harry
notes: Boost Software License 1.0 (per MTS page). A script that generates a UI-scaling package from the game's own assemblies. Only useful above 1080p or with the S3SS Resolution Spoofer. Published 2026-03-14. A .bat variant also exists (sha256 63cbc0f8351e1b89ee59197575cb467daf5df6b67081d223ee66ff4acd1d6406).
